01 / About
Engineering that ships

I'm a mechanical engineer with experience spanning mechanical design, R&D, simulation, and prototype development across defense radar, EV/battery, automotive, automation, autonomous systems, and thermal products.

My work runs the full loop — concept CAD in CATIA and SolidWorks, structural and thermal validation in ANSYS, GD&T manufacturing documentation, tolerance stack-up, and cross-functional execution through prototype builds and production release.

I also build Python engineering tools — battery pack DFM analyzers, precision tolerance stack-up engines, and autonomous sensor validation tools — to accelerate and automate the engineering process.

Open to roles in mechanical design, interiors/exterior/powertrain/chassis/battery structures, thermal design, quality, manufacturing, process, reliability, and technical program management.
